Ravi: quick sync 11 PT on vendor roadmap. topics: H100/H200/B200 slotting, MI300 ETA risk, Gaudi image freeze, marketplace listing windows.
Anya: i'll handle partner PR language. recommended wording: 'staged availability' not 'limited supply'.
Leo: H100 kernels ok. B200 waiting on vendor microcode patch; risk flagged. MI300 manifests shipped but ETA uncertain.
Sam: marketplace needs final SKU+perf cards by 4/9 to keep listing cadence. timeline ok if matrix in today.
ops-bot: note: Gaudi cluster experienced power derate; perf deviation ~5%. image freeze recommended after 4/14 validation.
Ravi: decision: internal canary 4/16, embargo 4/19-4/20, public announce 4/20 08:00 PT. agree?
Anya: yes. Priya will draft joint release and share with partners.
Leo: uploaded compat matrix -> s3://redwood/compat/hw-roadmap-2024-04.csv
Sam: pulling matrix now. will wire to marketplace canary route and set initial cap 150 qps.
Anya: fallback: if MI300 slips, route MI workloads to H200-verified builds. update messaging accordingly.
Ravi: blockers list for PR: B200 firmware, Gaudi power variance, MI300 ETA. please push short updates by EOD. reconvene 09:00 PT tomorrow for final gate. :thumbsup:
